title: Nourishing Snappy Canadian Lamb Kebabs
description: A romantic Canadian dish featuring lamb, with a winey and snappy flavor, perfect for a dinner date, and friendly to dairy-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together red wine, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is grilling, prepare the namul by blanching it in boiling water for 30 seconds, then seasoning it with lemon juice and salt.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before serving with the namul and your choice of sides.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with additional rosemary sprigs if desired.
